top_signals.title: Yen Pares BOJ-Fueled Declines as Nikkei Reports a Rate Check
top_signals.summary: The yen pared declines seen after the Bank of Japan disappointed traders who wanted clearer guidance on the central bank’s plans to further raise interest rates, with the Nikkei reporting that officials conducted a rate check in the currency market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The New Buffett Chairing Berkshire’s Board Knows the Firm Well
top_signals.summary: Howard Buffett, the eldest son of legendary investor Warren, is already well-versed in corporate governance as he takes over for his father as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen touches 158 to the dollar as market weighs further BOJ tightening pace
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: VW Slashes Outlook After China Sales Slump, Costs Weigh
top_signals.summary: Volkswagen AG slashed its profit forecast, citing a sharp contraction in China, restructuring costs and a €6 billion ($6.9 billion) writedown tied to sports-car maker Porsche AG. The shares slumped the most in a year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Medical AI has a proof problem
top_signals.summary: The technology’s advances have not yet translated into big improvements in real-life care
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CFTC submits crypto market regulation plan for White House review
top_signals.summary: The US commodities regulator submitted a new crypto market regulatory action for White House review days after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Kevin O’Leary is buying crypto again, says major stock exchange adoption is the ‘watershed moment’ to watch
top_signals.summary: Kevin O'Leary says he is buying crypto again and watching for a major stock exchange to adopt a blockchain network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: The Business of the $60 Loaf of Bread
top_signals.summary: Would you pay $60 for bread? At New York bakery RYE by Martin Auer, that's the going rate for a loaf eyed by influencers and the ultra-wealthy; we tried it to see what the fuss was all about. (Source: Bloomberg)
